contracts.asserts: Complete production handler/event units: nanopb request dispatch and wire presence/values; GetAll/notification/Set errors and recovery; relayed/self event application; one report per low-priority work invocation (order kept, newest dropped when full); zero/uint32 boundaries and sequential buffer reset. Five role/sleep/relay variants, O2 and ASan/UBSan.

Real kernel workqueue/message queue: full and continuously refilled report queue; exact protobuf source/idle/sleep values in order; queued peer runs after one report. Identical binary runs three times per scenario; assertion failure, timeout or crash fails.

limits: Activity/framework/event/Studio boundaries are controlled. The focused native fixture proves kernel queue scheduling, not physical USB/BLE/split delivery or a deadline for a synchronous send. Validation guards refuse before mutation, including a missing Set submessage. Setter/storage failures and durable multi-device application remain separate boundaries.
